run_conversational_chatbot: run a conversational chatbot using Groq and LangChain with conversation memory
create_chatgroq_client: create a ChatGroq client with an API key and model name for LLM calls
build_conversation_chain: build an LLMChain with a ChatPromptTemplate, memory, and Groq LLM for chat
configure_conversation_memory: configure a ConversationBufferWindowMemory to store the last N messages in chat history
review_chat_prompt_template: review the ChatPromptTemplate with system message, chat history placeholder, and human input
